title: Triage uncommitted src/ churn: ProviderSidebar deletion + diff component edits + provider-registry + dereference-worker

commits: 07d6ca2 feat(discovery): release-notes diff view + docusaurus provider registry
fc369a0 fix(ui): robustness — case-insensitive filters, error msg fallback, react keys, circular-ref guard
completion_evidence.verdicts: All 7 files classified KEEP. ProviderSidebar.jsx deletion documented via ADR-009 2026-04-22 amendment. provider-registry.js remained domain-pure (data-only shape change). No reverts.

context.problem: Seven files in src/ are uncommitted with no ADR rationale: (1) src/components/sidebar/ProviderSidebar.jsx DELETED (-222 lines) — last touched in 337d7e9 (dark-mode tokenization) so this is a deliberate removal, not a merge artifact. Zero remaining references to ProviderSidebar in src/ after deletion, which means something else now owns the sidebar UI or the feature is gone. (2) src/components/diff/DiffResults.jsx +133/-? — substantial addition, unknown intent. (3) DiffSummary.jsx, FetchProgress.jsx, VersionTimeline.jsx — small tweaks. (4) src/lib/domain/provider-registry.js — 17 LOC changed in a domain/ file; must verify no imports outside domain/ per hex rule. (5) src/workers/dereference-worker.js — 9 LOC changed. Either these are drafts that should be reverted, or they are shipped behavior that needs an ADR + commit trail before landing.
context.evidence_command: git status --short src/ && git diff HEAD -- src/

steps.name: Classify each file: keep-and-document vs revert
steps.description: For every file in files_at_risk, read `git diff HEAD` output and run the app locally (or at least `bun run build` + `hex analyze .`) to decide: (a) KEEP — behavior is correct and intended, needs ADR rationale; (b) REVERT — a draft or accidental edit; (c) SPLIT — part keep, part revert. Produce docs/workplans/src-churn-triage-2026-04-21.md with one row per file.
steps.done_condition: Triage file exists with a verdict for every entry in files_at_risk. Each KEEP row cites the feature it supports. Each REVERT row cites no remaining references.

steps.name: ProviderSidebar removal — ADR or revert
steps.description: ProviderSidebar.jsx deletion is the single largest change (-222 LOC) and has zero remaining references in src/. Either (a) write a new ADR that supersedes ADR-009 (popular-api-integrations-sidebar) explaining what replaced the sidebar and why, or (b) git restore src/components/sidebar/ProviderSidebar.jsx if this was accidental. Decision must match what the live app does — run the dev server and confirm whether any sidebar UI is still present.
steps.done_condition: Either a new ADR exists superseding ADR-009 with commit trail, or the file is restored. Not both, not neither.

steps.name: Domain-purity check on provider-registry.js diff
steps.description: src/lib/domain/provider-registry.js sits in domain/. Read the uncommitted diff and verify: no new imports from outside domain/, no adapter coupling, no framework deps. If the 17-line diff violates hex rule 1, revert the offending portion or move it to a usecases/ or adapters/ file.
steps.done_condition: hex analyze . reports clean for domain/. `grep -E "^import" src/lib/domain/provider-registry.js` shows only domain-internal paths or stdlib.

steps.name: Commit or revert per step-1 verdicts
steps.description: Execute the triage decisions. One commit per coherent group (e.g. 'feat(diff): <what DiffResults adds>', 'refactor(worker): <dereference-worker change>'). Any KEEP row must map to a commit; any REVERT row must result in `git restore`.
steps.done_condition: git status src/ shows zero uncommitted modifications. hex analyze . clean. All reachable routes render without console errors.
